items.text: For #BlackMaternalHealthWeek it was great to join the Dane County Health Council, the Foundation for Black Women’s Wellness, @AccessCHC and others to launch Connect Rx Wisconsin with a $3 million investment that I worked to provide @UWHealth. https://t.co/fsobypV9KC

Thanks to the Rebalanced-Life Wellness Association, the Perry Family Free Clinic, and @JPBehind_Chair for their innovative and effective work eliminating health disparities and bringing preventative healthcare to Black men in Dane County. ➡️https://t.co/8su616cmZW https://t.co/F5QQWJn3kc

It was great talking with @SecretaryPete about what the #RespectforMarriageAct means to him, his husband, and their two little ones. I’m proud that loving families like theirs can sleep a little better at night knowing their marriage will be respected & protected under the law! https://t.co/xpCsQFuIcC

Every person should be able to turn on the faucet & be confident that their drinking water is safe. I introduced the Healthy H20 Act with @SenatorCollins to help make that a reality by expanding water testing & treatment resources in rural communities.
 
https://t.co/hjSMfcOlJ6

My Healthy H2O Act ensures our small and rural communities aren’t left behind and delivers water testing and treatment resources to help remove dangerous chemicals like PFAS and protect the health of Wisconsin families.

https://t.co/MZIY9zUa5w

I’m proud to Light and Unite Red this week to highlight the dangers of substance use and recommit ourselves to providing our friends and neighbors with the prevention, treatment, and recovery resources they need. https://t.co/H1vzEtqUTU

Since Roe was overturned, medical students are struggling just to get basic reproductive training. I introduced a bill that would expand access to this training to help ensure women can exercise their right to control their bodies & access abortion care. https://t.co/YjPeZT0hMX

I‘ll always fight to grow Wisconsin’s middle class, strengthen our economy, & give families the security they need to sleep well at night. 

Proud of the work we’ve made to create good paying jobs, cut RX drug costs, & boost U.S. manufacturing – but know we have more to do.

It’s crucial that our doctors have access to proper reproductive health care training to ensure women can exercise the right & freedom to control their own bodies. My bill would make sure that training is available for Wisconsin medical students like Sami.
https://t.co/ZOXzbvz7ge

Fentanyl & tranq are devastating communities across Wisconsin, & it’s going to take all of us to end this deadly epidemic. Great to be in Milwaukee to talk about our work to stop these drugs from coming into our communities, boost treatment & prevention efforts, & save lives. https://t.co/hzzOLmIyCU

I’m fighting to get dangerous drugs like fentanyl and tranq out of our communities and expand prevention and treatment resources to save lives. It was encouraging to meet with community members and see that work being done right here in Milwaukee. https://t.co/mQDVmOhf4F

Inflation 📉+ Wages 📈= good news for working families.

I’m proud that our economic plan I fought hard to pass is delivering results for Wisconsin families, but I know we have more work to do to cut household costs & give people the security they need to sleep well at night.

Spent my day in Appleton talking with health experts and community leaders about tackling the fentanyl crisis in our state. We need to stop these drugs from coming into the country, boost prevention & treatment support, & increase access to life saving overdose reversal drugs. https://t.co/HV6AtyxvlT

It’s going to take every tool we have to end the deadly fentanyl crisis in our state, and I was glad to hear about the great work our community leaders in Appleton are doing to expand prevention and treatment resources & keep our communities safe. https://t.co/1IEt6qasQ7

From a new wastewater treatment facility to a new technical education center, it was wonderful to see how the City of Osseo is using federal funds I helped deliver to ensure community members can lead healthy lives, land good-paying jobs, and grow the local economy. https://t.co/qEZTbNJdU9

Because of Wisconsin’s criminal 1849 abortion ban, women across our state are being forced to travel out of state just to exercise their freedom to control their own bodies, creating a healthcare crisis & leaving our neighboring states feeling the impacts. https://t.co/I5HHSE4nh8

Fighting the fentanyl and opioid crisis in Wisconsin would not be possible without incredible advocates like the ones here in South Central Wisconsin. 

I’m proud to partner with them in our fight to expand prevention, treatment, and recovery resources and save lives. https://t.co/ObIsx43VYZ

Wisconsin communities have been shattered by the fentanyl & opioid crisis & we must stop this epidemic in its tracks. 

My bipartisan bill will help curb this crisis by investing in prevention, treatment, & law enforcement efforts. Glad we’re one step closer to it becoming law. https://t.co/e62pLI51DD

My heart is heavy reading story after story like this & I refuse to let this be our new norm. I’m working to stop these drugs from entering our communities, support law enforcement efforts, & expand prevention & treatment resources to save lives.

https://t.co/pI5m3LU3VD

Families should be spending the holidays with loved ones but that isn’t the case for too many Wisconsinites due to the opioid & fentanyl epidemic. 

I’m fighting this crisis on all fronts & glad my bill to invest in prevention, treatment, & recovery efforts is moving forward. https://t.co/yomWPOrTId

Big drug companies that make inhalers are limiting competition and locking out cheaper alternatives, leaving Wisconsin families with fewer treatment options and higher costs for their life saving inhalers. 

It’s wrong, and I’m saying no more. https://t.co/yi43zG0JM2

One death from fentanyl & opioids is one too many. 
 
1,400 is unacceptable.

To tackle this crisis, we need to crack down on Chinese chemical suppliers, secure our border, & invest in local prevention, treatment, & recovery resources — & I’m working to do just that. https://t.co/4pyitpbPhy

While half of Americans will experience menopause in their lifetime, under-investment in research and education has left too many women with limited treatment options and oftentimes debilitating symptoms. I’m fighting to change that & get Americans the care they deserve. https://t.co/ST7sgxqGQR

Wisconsin is in a maternal mortality crisis, and we need to do more to support new and expecting mothers and their babies. Proud to partner with @RepGwenMoore to help more new mothers get the mental health and wellness support they need to stay healthy.
https://t.co/56Vdgt0ZwQ

Like too many, I know what it's like to have family that struggles with addiction. I’m fighting the opioid & fentanyl crisis on all fronts – from helping boost prevention & treatment efforts to stopping the production of dangerous drugs abroad. https://t.co/2tq08r5T6u
